#  35442 - Sustainable Use of Underground Resources, Geothermal Energy and CO2 Storage Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **35442 - module is no longer offered from WS 2016/17**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Sustainable Use of Underground Resources, Geothermal Energy and CO2 Storage**  |  
|  Nachhaltige Nutzung geologischer Ressourcen, Geothermie und CO2 Speicherung   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 3 - Mechanical Engineering, Electrical and Energy Systems   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Schwarz, Harald 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Students will get a deeper understanding the exploration thermal energy reservoirs or depth section area to sequestrate CO2 and the necessary technology for these proceses  |  
| Contents:  | The lecture encounters basic knowledge for the geo-energetic utilization of underground reservoirs. The lecture helps to understand the basic geology needed for the exploration of geothermal energy reservoirs or of the depth sections to sequestrate CO2 and shows up the practice to make access to these reservoirs by drilling and the engineering of the reservoir by enhancing methods. The lecture describes the technology to make use of the Earth’s heat for direct use, power, and/or chill and gives boundary conditions for its economic and environmental utilization.Main chapters: 1) Exploration with Reservoir Definition and Exploration Methods, 2) Development with Drilling into the interesting Reservoirs, 3) Reservoir Engineering incl. Enhancing Methods and Reservoirs in Operation, 4) Process Engineering with Direct Use and Conversion of Earth’s Heat into Chill or Power, Economics and Environmental Impact and specific aspects of Carbon capture.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Knowledges:
  * Basics in physics and natural sciences

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 3 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 75 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | web based lecture script  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Written examination, 90 min 

or 
  * verbal examination, 30 min

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | ****Lectures will be not offered in winter semester 2015/2016.****  |  
| Module Components:  | Sustainable Use of Underground Resources, Geothermal Energy and CO2 Storage (Vorlesung)  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
